description: We’re WorkLifeBalance, five students building MOONSHIFT, a browser game for kids 7–12. Players are B.E.E.P., a lunar robot keeping three astronauts safe through five shifts as a real 2017 solar storm (NASA DONKI data) heads their way. Every choice costs power, food or shielding. Our skills span game development (React, Three.js), 3D art, UI/UX, sound and science research, and Mission 1 already plays end to end in the browser with no install.
